params.congressCandidateRegistryAddress: The Congress registry used for active-member checks.
params.identityRegistryAddress: The identity registry used for stake-recipient validation.
params.llmTokenAddress: The LLM token pulled for transfer-and-stake decisions.
params.officeRegistryAddress: The office registry used for ministry role checks and clerk decisions.
params.stakeRegistryAddress: The stake registry updated by LLM transfer-and-stake decisions.

params.amount: The amount to fund in the asset's smallest units.
params.officeId: The office/ministry to credit; must already exist.
params.source: The wallet funding the ministry; must approve this app for the amount before execution.

params.admin: The address granted the office admin role on creation.
params.kind: The office kind that determines the admin's operational powers.
params.name: The human-readable office name.
params.officeId: The identifier of the new office to create; must not already exist.

congressCandidateRegistry().notice: Returns the configured Congress candidate registry address.

createCongressFundMinistryDecision(bytes.notice: Opens a Congress decision to fund a ministry/office balance in the MinistryTreasury. On majority         approval the source wallet's tokens are pulled and credited to the office's balance. Congress-gated         so the regular money flow is not subject to citizen-referendum friction.

createCongressRegisterOfficeDecision(byt.notice: Opens a Congress decision to create a new government office or ministry. On majority approval the         office is registered with the given kind, name, and admin, letting the polity add offices after         genesis without redeploying the office bootstrap authority.

createCongressTokenTransferDecision(byte.notice: Opens a Congress decision to transfer an ERC20 from a source wallet to a recipient.

executeMinistryDecision(bytes32).notice: Executes a prepared ministry decision. The minister wallet must sign the execution transaction.

hasCongressSupported(bytes32,address).notice: Returns true when a Congress member has supported a Congress decision.

identityRegistry().notice: Returns the configured identity registry address.

llmToken().notice: Returns the LLM token accepted for transfer-and-stake decisions.

officeRegistry().notice: Returns the configured office registry address.

prepareMinistryClerkDecision(bytes32,byt.notice: Prepares a ministry clerk add/remove decision. A clerk or minister may prepare it.

prepareMinistryLlmStakeDecision(bytes32,.notice: Prepares a ministry LLM transfer-and-stake decision. A clerk or minister may prepare it.

prepareMinistryTokenTransferDecision(byt.notice: Prepares a ministry ERC20 transfer decision. A clerk or minister may prepare it.

requiredCongressSupport().notice: Returns the required majority support for the current Congress term.

revokeCongressDecisionSupport(bytes32).notice: Removes caller support from a Congress decision.

stakeRegistry().notice: Returns the configured stake registry address.

supportCongressDecision(bytes32).notice: Records caller support for a Congress decision.
